notes: Posted 24 July 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as marked in the list: the Objective, Cloud City: Upper Walkway ('start w/ objective'), Secret Plans ('star with objective'), Prepared Defenses ('st'), I'm Sorry, Crush The Rebellion and Mobilization Points ('starting'); these count toward the 60. Carida, Cloud City: West Gallery and Cloud City: Upper Plaza Corridor are pulled before activation with Mobilization Points and I'm Sorry.
Posted 'TDIGWATT/PIDAIAF' dested This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further. Posted 'control' dested the Dark Dagobah interrupt Control (Dark).

Posted 'Tarkin' dested Grand Moff Tarkin (the era's Dark Tarkin card); 'Jodo' Jodo Kast (named in the strategy); 'Jade' Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand (the deck runs Mara's Saber and the strategy calls her 'mara'); '4-lom with blaster' 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'BinBus' Bossk In Hound's Tooth; 'Dr. E and Ponda B' Dr. Evazan & •Ponda Baba; 'Xizor' Prince Xizor; 'Thrawn' Grand Admiral Thrawn; 'ozzel' Admiral Ozzel; 'ZinMH' Zuckuss In Mist Hunter; 'Fett in slave 1' Boba Fett In Slave I.

Posted 'CC Upper Plaza' dested the Dark Cloud City: Upper Plaza Corridor (Dark), whose Dark Side text lets characters move between it and any Cloud City site for free, as the strategy describes; 'CC West Gallery' Cloud City: West Gallery (Dark); 'Bespin' Bespin (Dark); 'Bespin CC' Bespin: Cloud City (Dark); 'CC Occupation' Cloud City Occupation; 'Mob. Points' Mobilization Points; 'Search + Destroy' Search And Destroy.

Posted 'Oo-ta Goo-ta, Solo?' (marked 'Mecca') dested the printed A New Hope interrupt; 'Fanfare' is the 2001 Effect, not a Defensive Shield. There'll Be Hell To Pay is an Effect though posted under interrupts.
The strategy says the deck went undefeated at an unnamed local tournament; no event is named, so it stays a general deck.
